methodology.label: Our methodology
methodology.title: A verified-skills marketplace — not self-declared
methodology.p1: Big-Up is grounded in scientifically validated psychometric frameworks. Our assessments measure cognitive skills, professional aptitudes, and behavioral traits using models that have been used in HR selection for over 50 years.
methodology.p2: Every score is computed from standardized algorithms, verifiable by both Talent and Recruiter. No skill displayed on Big-Up is self-declared — it's measured.
methodology.banner: Phase 1 — Now launching. Join the founding cohort of talents.
